help.title: How to use CodifyQR
help.intro: Make a QR code in five steps. Everything happens on your device.
help.s1.d: Choose the type: a link, Pix, Wi-Fi, contact, WhatsApp and more. The number keys 1 to 0 also switch it.
help.s2.d: Type the fields. The preview updates as you type. Fields marked with * are required.
help.s3.d: Open Style to change shapes and colors and to add a logo. Frame puts the code on a sticker, card or sign.
help.s4.d: The panel on the right tests the code the way a phone camera would. Green means it reads fine. Yellow or red says why and offers a one-click fix.
help.s5.d: PNG for screens and social media, SVG for the printer or a designer, PDF with the real size for printing at home, or copy the image.
help.tips.title: Tips for printing
help.tips.1: Print at least 2 cm wide. Bigger is safer, and more text makes the code denser.
help.tips.2: Keep dark modules on a light background. Light on dark often fails.
help.tips.3: Keep the white border around the code. Do not crop it.
help.tips.4: Test with your own phone before printing a batch.
help.terms.title: Words you may see
help.term.ecc: Error correction: extra data that lets a code read even when part of it is dirty or covered. A logo uses some of it.
help.term.version: Version: the size of the code, from 1 (small) to 40 (large). More text means a higher version.
help.term.static: Static: the content is inside the image. It never expires and needs no server.
help.pix.title: About Pix
help.pix.d: The code carries your key, name and an optional amount, so the payer's bank app fills in everything.
shortcuts.tools: Previous or next tool (Create, Batch, Scan)
shortcuts.singleHint: Turn off if they get in the way of your keyboard or screen reader. Combinations with Ctrl keep working.
